periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted approximately 45 to 60 degrees downward toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a length-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering at the inferior margin, creating a teardrop-like extension below the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape with a relatively linear and uniform posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial, occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible longitudinal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation with a distinct white gap occupying the majority of the cranial crown.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, hemispherical curvature at the superior boundary of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable tan or light-brownish discoloration present across the posterior dorsal and flank pelage.
